sources_chirho.license_chirho: Public domain as stated, not CC0. glosses/README.md first carried "The Holy Bible, Berean Interlinear Bible, BIB, Copyright 2016 by Bible Hub, Used by Permission. They do not itemize the interlinear glosses; applying the dedication to them is an inference. The 2026-10-27 release check (spec-chirho/research-chirho/26-10-27-release-license-check-chirho.md) found no current rights claim on the interlinear's own pages (interlinearbible.com, which shows a "Free Licensing" link, and the biblehub.com interlinear). Berean also asks that the Berean name not be used for derivative works that vary from the official text.
